Endpoint: POST /panorra/auth
Current code: Panorra\PanorraController@loginPanorra
Category: B - already delegates to Panorra\Actions\LoginPanorra, so this is a mechanical conformance pass. Wrap with DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope.

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1558 (panorra/1549-login, merged into main) - the first PR in the 9-PR Panorra domain migration stack (#1549, #1550, #1551, #1552, #1553, #1554, #1555, #1556, #1557), introducing the Panorra ADR domain scaffold used by the rest of the stack.

  • New Panorra\Auth\LoginPanorraController -> LoginPanorraAction -> PanorraRepository + LoginPanorraDto, replacing legacy Panorra\Actions\LoginPanorra::execute().
  • New PanorraRepository - wraps the auth_panorra table (gothru_mod connection), replacing DatabaseClass::tableAuthPanorra() / PanorraHelpers for this endpoint.
  • New PanorraDomainException base + PanorraExceptionHttpMapper.
  • Email-uniqueness check, upstream Panorra login call, account upsert (default-flag handling), and the encrypted success envelope preserved 1:1 from the legacy Action.
  • Review fix folded in before merge: LoginPanorraDto::fromRequest() now rejects a non-boolean-ish default value with PanorraValidationException instead of silently coercing it to false via filter_var.
  • Legacy PanorraController::loginPanorra() method + app/Http/Controllers/Panorra/Actions/LoginPanorra.php removed (other 8 legacy methods untouched, handled by later PRs in the stack).
domainCode HTTP Condition
PANORRA.VALIDATION_FAILED 400 Required email/password missing, or default present but not boolean-ish
PANORRA.EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS 409 Panorra email already linked to another GoThru user
PANORRA.CONNECT_FAILED 400 Upstream Panorra login call failed, or persisting the account afterward failed

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path Description
POST /panorra/auth Logs a user into Panorra with email/password and links the account to the authenticated GoThru user.

issues.main_description_html:
Migrate this endpoint to the Domain-Based ADR architecture.

Endpoint: POST /panorra/update-status-account
Current code: Panorra\PanorraController@updateStatusPanorraAccount
Category: B - already delegates to Panorra\Actions\UpdateStatusPanorraAccount, so this is a mechanical conformance pass. Wrap with DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope.

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1564 (panorra/1555-update-account-status, merged into main) - the seventh PR in the 9-PR Panorra domain migration stack (#1549, #1550, #1551, #1552, #1553, #1554, #1555, #1556, #1557), extending the Panorra ADR scaffold introduced earlier in the stack.

  • New Panorra\Account\UpdateStatusPanorraAccountController -> UpdateStatusPanorraAccountAction -> PanorraRepository + UpdateStatusPanorraAccountDto, replacing legacy Panorra\Actions\UpdateStatusPanorraAccount::execute().
  • PanorraRepository extended with linked-account lookup by email and soft-delete/mark-deleted support for Panorra accounts.
  • No new domain exception classes were required; the endpoint reuses existing Panorra domain codes for invalid input and missing linked account.
  • Endpoint intentionally remains unauthenticated, matching legacy behavior because it is called by Panorra itself rather than by an authenticated GoThru user.
  • Email lookup and account deletion behavior preserved from the legacy Action while returning through the ADR controller/action/envelope flow.
  • Review/hardening fix folded in before merge: email_panorra is validated as a well-formed email before the repository lookup/update path runs.
  • Legacy PanorraController::updateStatusPanorraAccount() method + app/Http/Controllers/Panorra/Actions/UpdateStatusPanorraAccount.php removed (other 2 legacy methods untouched, handled by later PRs in the stack).
  • Added focused coverage for DTO validation, controller response mapping, and action behavior.
domainCode HTTP Condition
PANORRA.INPUT_INVALID 409 Missing or invalid email_panorra
PANORRA.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED 409 email_panorra does not match a linked Panorra account

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path Description
POST /panorra/update-status-account Marks a Panorra account, identified by email_panorra, as deleted.

QA Result - 2026-07-08

Status: Failed - Bug found
Type: Coding bug, not setup issue
Coverage: Static ADR/API contract test via Playwright source assertions

Test Command

node node_modules\@playwright\test\cli.js test --grep "#1555"

Result

  • Failed: qa_testing/api/panorra/issue_1555_update_status_account_api.spec.js
  • Failing check: [Black Box] verify invalid and not-connected paths are conditioned without fallback HTTP 500

Findings

  • ADR route migration is present: POST /panorra/update-status-account maps to Panorra\Account\UpdateStatusPanorraAccountController@handle.
  • Controller, action, DTO, repository, exception mapper, docs, and focused tests exist.
  • Legacy route/controller action was removed from this endpoint scope.
  • Domain mapping exists for:
    • PANORRA.INPUT_INVALID -> 409
    • PANORRA.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED -> 409

Bug

email_panorra is not validated as a well-formed email before repository lookup/update.

Current source:

  • app/DTOs/Panorra/UpdateStatusPanorraAccountDto.php only checks email_panorra exists and is a string.
  • app/Actions/Panorra/UpdateStatusPanorraAccountAction.php only checks the string is not empty.
  • No FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL or equivalent email-format validation exists in the DTO/action path.
  • Existing tests cover missing, non-string, unknown account, and success, but do not cover malformed email format.

Impact:

  • A malformed string like not-an-email can reach PanorraRepository::existsByEmail(...).
  • That can return PANORRA.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED instead of the expected PANORRA.INPUT_INVALID.
  • This violates the developer note: "email_panorra is validated as a well-formed email before the repository lookup/update path runs."

HTTP 500 Check

No scoped, deterministic HTTP 500 path was proven for this issue during static validation. The blocker is still a coding bug because malformed email input is not conditioned as invalid input before repository access.

Required Developer Fix

Validate email_panorra format before repository lookup/update, preferably in UpdateStatusPanorraAccountDto::fromRequest(...) or before existsByEmail(...) in the action:

  • Missing / non-string / empty / malformed email -> PANORRA.INPUT_INVALID with HTTP 409.
  • Unknown but well-formed email -> PANORRA.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED with HTTP 409.
  • Add DTO/controller test coverage for malformed email such as not-an-email.
